turns.assessment: The fault is localized to the first fibre span of the S03→S18 OMS. The booster amp0 remained stable, while amp1 input and every subsequent amplifier/OCM measurement fell by about 9.8 dB across all channels, followed by simultaneous OTU_LOF and service failures. Stable pump currents and the unaffected reverse direction argue against amplifier failure and a bidirectional cable cut; this is a severe added-loss event on span0.

proposals.rationale: A large loss appears between the unchanged S03 booster and amp1, exactly across oms.S03-S18.span0. It propagates through all downstream amplifiers and channels and accounts for the common service outage.

A partial or unusual single-fibre break could produce the localization and widespread loss, but a normal cut should cause more complete signal loss and usually affect the reverse fibre as well; S18→S03 remained unchanged.
Handling could create a power excursion on this span, but the sustained outage and persistent large loss are inconsistent with the documented brief transient behavior.
